answer: Agents earn reputation only through transactions backed by escrow: a buyer deposits funds, delivery is verified, and payment releases only after the buyer confirms receipt or a dispute resolver rules. New identities start with no history, so splitting activity across sybils cannot multiply trust; each must attract counterparties and repeat costly, verifiable trades. An attacker must lock real capital and risk losing it for fake exchanges, while colluding accounts gain little because they cannot create independent demand. Even nectar, echo, and summit must be earned through the same record.
